scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

card.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden

button.primary: bg-[#005EB8] hover:bg-[#004C97] text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-colors
button.secondary: bg-[#E8EDEE] hover:bg-[#D8DEDF] text-[#0A1128] font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-colors
button.destructive: bg-[#D5281B] hover:bg-[#B32015] text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-colors
button.outline: bg-transparent border border-[#005EB8] text-[#005EB8] hover:bg-slate-50 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-colors

wait_time_display.unlock_overlay: absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-[2px] z-10 p-4 rounded-lg

wait_time_display.pill_medium: bg-[#FFF8E5] text-[#B38000] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold border border-[#FFB81C]/30
wait_time_display.pill_low: bg-[#E5F2E8] text-[#007F3B] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold border border-[#007F3B]/20

input.base: w-full border-2 border-slate-300 rounded-md p-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A1128] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#FFEB3B]/50 transition-all text-slate-900
input.label: block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1

hospital_exterior_alt.description: Low angle view of a modern hospital against a clear blue sky

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Manrope' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Do NOT use Inter.
Implement the NHS Blue (#005EB8) as the primary brand color. Use #D5281B for high wait times, #FFB81C for medium, and #007F3B for low wait times.
For non-paying users, blur the wait times using `blur-md opacity-50 select-none` and overlay a clear CTA to pay £4.99 via PayPal to unlock.
The search hero section must be highly prominent and use the `hero_bg` image with a dark overlay (`bg-slate-900/60`) for text contrast.
Use solid white backgrounds with 1px border (`border-slate-200`) and slight shadow (`shadow-sm`) for cards.
Data updates: users can update every 15 mins, include 'Last updated' timestamp on every wait time card clearly visible.
Admin dashboard: simple, list-based, with options to 'Approve Hospital' or 'Override Wait Time'. Use a compact table view.
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, list items).
